insight: Croatia's performance during hydration breaks in the 2026 World Cup has been notable, as they managed to gain momentum in all 8 breaks, with an average increase of 0.125 minutes per break. This suggests that the team is able to effectively use these breaks to regroup and refocus, leading to a positive impact on their overall performance. Interestingly, when Croatia was pressing before a hydration break, they failed to gain any additional momentum, but when they were not pressing, they saw a slightly higher average increase in momentum, indicating that the breaks may be particularly beneficial for the team when they are not already exerting high pressure on their opponents. Overall, the data suggests that hydration breaks have been a valuable tool for Croatia, allowing them to recharge and come back stronger in matches.
